description:
One rotation's full item list. One rotation as the wiki's /store/rotation page shows it: `rotation` (`id`, `name`, `start`, `end`,
`itemdefid_count` - the number of items that still resolve in the catalogue) and its items split into
`limited_time`, `general` and `dlc_packs`, each item in the same shape as GET /store, including today's
`market_price` and `is_available_on_store` (a past rotation can still contain evergreen catalogue items).
Cached for an hour.
name: get_store_rotation
